subject: Australia industrial pathway brief — Starfleet Australia / Kangaroo-class (exploratory, for SpaceX adjacency)
body:
Hello Australian Space Agency team,

I am Crystal Elle Arena-Turner (TerAustralis Incognita, Sydney). Attached is a short, fact-checked industrial brief framing Australia as a possible allied second-hemisphere option for launch / recovery / manufacturing / crew training — written for SpaceX / SpaceXAI exploratory conversation.

It maps to the July 2026 Statement on Space (spaceflight ecosystem, platforms, microgravity, trusted services) and stays inside hard boundaries: no Starship MoU claimed, ELA not live, Eris not orbital yet.

Ask: happy to take a short call on how ASA prefers industry concepts like this to be routed when the counterpart is a US launch operator under the TSA.

Thank you,
Crystal Elle Arena-Turner
Chief Engineer (concept lead)
